name: Juan Pablo Calderón
headline: Senior Data Scientist (Ph.D.) | Machine Learning & MLOps | AI & Data Solutions Consultant
summary: Senior Data Scientist (Ph.D.) con más de 6 años de experiencia resolviendo problemas complejos con Machine Learning. Especializado en pipelines de datos automatizados (Python/SQL), modelos productivos y despliegue cloud (AWS SageMaker, MLOps), combinando rigor científico y entrega de impacto en negocio.

highlights: Designed and implemented end-to-end MLOps pipelines using AWS SageMaker for training, tuning and deployment.
Orchestrated data processing and inference dependencies with AWS Step Functions.
Developed time-series forecasting models for strategic planning.
Built high-impact feature engineering workflows in Python and SQL.
Research on low-surface-brightness elliptical galaxies with deep photometry and spectroscopy.
Cross-comparison between observed structural parameters and hydrodynamical simulations (Illustris).
Advanced analysis of early-type galaxies in Antlia and Fornax environments.
Integrated observational data with statistical modeling and simulation outputs.
Extended quantitative analysis of early-type galaxies across Antlia cluster regions.
Implemented reproducible pipelines for deep imaging and spectroscopy integration.
Teaching and mentoring in stellar astronomy and quantitative analysis methods.
